deliverables.summary: Ten-stage conversion pipeline with determinism classes, four source shapes, 23 negative paths, four worked traces.
18 mechanism records across 8 stages; 9 distinct first-party specifications; every row carries limitations and a falsifier.
Receipt schema extending Block Contract v1 evidence_receipt; 18 receipt types (14 inherited + 3 proposed + 1 refinement); 8 stage payloads; 9 total defs; fixture validated.

key_findings.claim: Identity, not rights, is the first blocker: no corpus repository is currently pinnable.
key_findings.evidence: phase-7/lanes/05-rights-eval-readiness/outputs/rights-provenance-ledger.jsonl record P7-RER-RIGHTS-001: immutable_commit_or_tag NOT_CAPTURED; access_status recorded_public_url_not_independently_resolved; source_content_digest NOT_AVAILABLE.
key_findings.falsifier: Read every ledger row's immutable_commit_or_tag; any populated value refutes universality.

key_findings.claim: The largest local asset is rights-blocked by omission: 21st.dev component metadata has no license field, which is NOASSERTION under SPDX 2.3, not permission.
key_findings.evidence: siso-ui-base/registry/21st/code/19077-editorial-image-hero/meta.json keys contain no license; SPDX 2.3 7.13/7.15 state an omitted license field carries a meaning equivalent to NOASSERTION.
key_findings.falsifier: Retrieve first-party 21st.dev licensing terms; a registry-level grant would refute this.

key_findings.claim: Harvest breadth is not conversion readiness.
key_findings.evidence: classification.json stats harvested 7949, tagged 3951, untagged 3998; catalog.json 832 entries; registry/21st/code/ contains exactly 2 component directories.
key_findings.falsifier: Enumerate code/ and find more than 2 directories.

key_findings.claim: The contract receipt vocabulary has three holes at the stages that gate everything else: source_identity, dependency_closure, shape_decision.
key_findings.evidence: Block Contract v1 evidence_receipt.receipt_type enumerates 14 values; none covers Stage 0, Stage 2, or Stage 3.
key_findings.falsifier: Lane 01 shows an existing receipt_type that carries identity, closure, or shape decisions.

key_findings.claim: Repo-to-block conversion cannot be fully automated; Stages 2, 6 and 10 require a named human.
key_findings.evidence: Shape decision, adaptation-safety acceptance, and admission are judgment calls; Block Contract v1 admission.implementation_authorized is const false.
key_findings.falsifier: Demonstrate a shape decision and an adaptation-safety acceptance made mechanically with a stable, defensible rule.
